info.description:
### Change Log

| Change Type | Group | Sub-Group | Endpoint | Breaking Change | Action | Description |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| 📦 New | Accounts Payable | Invoices | General Ledger Invoice | No | POST, PUT | New endpoints added to create and update a supplier general ledger invoice with GL distribution lines. |
| 📦 New | Accounts Payable | Invoices | General Ledger Invoice | No | POST | New endpoint added to cancel a supplier general ledger invoice by creating and applying an offsetting credit note. |
| 📦 New | Accounts Payable | Invoices | Purchase Order Invoice | No | POST, PUT | New endpoints added to create and update a supplier purchase order invoice. |
| 📦 New | Accounts Payable | Invoices | Purchase Order Invoice | No | POST | New endpoint added to cancel a supplier purchase order invoice by creating and applying an offsetting credit note. |
| 📦 New | Accounts Payable | Invoices | Purchase Order Invoice Attachments | No | GET, POST, DELETE | New endpoints added to retrieve, download, upload and delete attachments for a supplier purchase order invoice. |
| 📦 New | Accounts Payable | Invoices | Hold Payment | No | PUT | New endpoint added to update the hold payment status of a supplier invoice, with staff kiosk invoice approval workflow support. |
| 📦 New | Accounts Payable | Credits | Unapply Credits | No | POST | New endpoint added to reverse all invoice applications for a supplier credit. |
| 📦 New | Accounts Payable | Credits | Apply Credits | No | POST | New endpoint added to apply credit amounts to one or more unpaid supplier invoices, with support for auto-allocation. |
| 📦 New | Accounts Payable | Credits | Credits Attachments | No | GET, POST, DELETE | New endpoint added to retrieve, download, upload and delete attachments for a supplier credit. |
| 📦 New | Accounts Payable | Credits | Credits | No | GET, POST, PUT | New endpoint added to retrieve, add and update supplier credits with GL distribution lines and applied invoices. |
| 📦 New | General Ledger | Accounts | Account Transactions | No | GET | New endpoint added to retrieve all account transactions for a given period across all accounts. |

get.description:
Retrieves a list of all student attendance records for a specified company code.

- ##### **Endpoint Details**  
    | Group | Sub-Group | Name | Permission |
    |:------|:----------|:-----|:-----------|
    | Students | Attendance | Student Attendance | Read |

- ##### **OData Functionality**
    | Functions | | | | |
    |:------|:------|:------|:------|:------|
    | ✅ $select | ✅ $filter | ✅ $orderby | ✅ $top (max 500) | ✅ $skip |

- ##### **⚠️ Please note**
    - Student information such as boarder, house, year group, campus etc. are from when the absence was recorded, they are not current values.
    - If this student information was not archived as at the absence date, then these values are not obtainable and will be returned as null.

- ##### **Purpose**
    - Retrieves a list of students whose photos have been updated, returning only the most recent photo change per student.
    - This endpoint supports incremental synchronization through a change tracking mechanism.

- ##### **How It Works**
    - Initial Request (no change_key)
         - Call `GET /students/photo/changes`
         - Returns all students with photo updates, one record per student (the most recent photo change)
         - Response includes a `change_key` for subsequent requests

    - Incremental Sync (with change_key)
         - Call `GET /students/photo/changes?change_key={ previous_change_key }`
         - Returns only students whose photos were updated AFTER the provided change_key
         - Response includes a new `change_key` for the next request

- ##### **Use Cases**
    - *Full Sync:* Omit `change_key` to get all student photo changes
    - *Incremental Sync:* Use the `change_key` from the previous response to poll for new changes
    - *Photo Management:* Track which student photos need to be refreshed in external systems

    | ❌ $select | ❌ $filter | ❌ $orderby | ❌ $top | ❌ $skip |

- ##### **Business Rules**
    - Invoice must exist and be a purchase order invoice
    - When the `multipleAttachmentInvoice` feature is disabled only a single attachment is allowed; when enabled up to five are allowed
    - The file is stored in the next available attachment slot

- ##### **Comments**
    - A DIGEST header will be returned with the response. This will contain the SHA-256 hash of the file content. The value in the header is base64 encoded and will need to be decoded before checking against the file content.

- ##### **Purpose**
    - Retrieves a list of employees whose photos have been updated, returning only the most recent photo change per employee.
    - This endpoint supports incremental synchronization through a change tracking mechanism.

- ##### **How It Works**
    - Initial Request (no change_key)
         - Call `GET /employees/photo/changes`
         - Returns all employees with photo updates, one record per employee (the most recent photo change)
         - Response includes a `change_key` for subsequent requests

    - Incremental Sync (with change_key)
         - Call `GET /employees/photo/changes?change_key={ previous_change_key }`
         - Returns only employees whose photos were updated AFTER the provided change_key
         - Response includes a new `change_key` for the next request

- ##### **Use Cases**
    - *Full Sync:* Omit `change_key` to get all employee photo changes
    - *Incremental Sync:* Use the `change_key` from the previous response to poll for new changes
    - *Photo Management:* Track which employee photos need to be refreshed in external systems
